ambiguity.detail: Clarissa is mentioned as someone else who married the unnamed man.

verdict.hook_line: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: You know nothing about my world.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A chained woman proudly declares she prefers her loving poor husband over a wealthy, status-obsessed ex.
verdict.why_it_works: Presents a strong emotional and thematic contrast between superficial aristocratic greed and genuine true love.
